description: This Python module provides utilities for aligning and correcting subtitle entries using Whisper model transcripts. It includes functions for normalizing text, merging blank subtitles, matching subtitles with transcript segments, and ensuring monotonic timestamps to produce accurate, well-structured subtitles.

methods.name: bool _is_blank(text: Optional[str])
methods.description: Checks if the provided text is None or only whitespace.

methods.name: str _normalize_space(text: str)
methods.description: Normalizes whitespace in the text, collapsing multiple spaces and trimming.

methods.name: float _overlap(a: Tuple[float, float], b: Tuple[float, float])
methods.description: Calculates the overlap duration between two time intervals.

methods.name: float _interval_center(iv: Tuple[float, float])
methods.description: Returns the center point of a given time interval.

methods.name: float _safe_time(t: float)
methods.description: Ensures that a timestamp is non-negative by clamping negatives to zero.

methods.name: None _ensure_monotonic(subs: List[Dict], min_gap: float = 0.02)
methods.description: Adjusts subtitle timings in-place to be monotonic and non-overlapping with minimal gaps.

methods.name: Optional[int] _match_transcript_segment( sub_iv: Tuple[float, float], transcript: List[Dict], )
methods.description: Finds the best matching transcript segment index for a given subtitle interval based on overlap and proximity.

methods.name: Optional[int] _closest_transcript_index_by_time(point: float, transcript: List[Dict])
methods.description: Finds the index of the transcript segment closest in center time to a given point.

methods.name: List[Dict] _merge_adjacent_blanks(subs: List[Dict])
methods.description: Merges consecutive blank-text subtitles to reduce fragmentation.

methods.name: None _apply_text_from_transcript(sub: Dict, seg: Dict)
methods.description: Updates subtitle text from the transcript segment if missing or to normalize spacing.

methods.name: None _refit_times_to_segment(sub: Dict, seg: Dict)
methods.description: Adjusts subtitle start/end times to better fit within a transcript segment while maintaining relative duration and constraints.

methods.name: List[Dict] align_subtitles(transcript: List[Dict], subtitles: List[Dict])
methods.description: Main function to align and correct subtitles using a Whisper transcript, ensuring better timing, text accuracy, and consistency.

ctags.name: _overlap
ctags.pattern: /^def _overlap(a: Tuple[float, float], b: Tuple[float, float]) -> float:$/
